scope.compatibleSystems: voxel destruction where visible blocks are expected to fragment independently

rules: canonical structural planner decides destroyed/unsupported voxels
visible debris uses bounded independent per-voxel rigid bodies
fragment impulses are deterministic and distinct
strict per-shot and active fragment budgets
weak/software devices reduce rendering and physics cost before reducing fragmentation semantics
browser regression must prove unique voxel bodies and increasing pairwise spread

scope.compatibleSystems: procedural worlds that require endless traversable architecture across streamed cells

rules: connectivity topology is generated before architecture
every active traversal cell exposes deterministic cardinal portals
neighbor connections use symmetric canonical edge keys
visible portal openings are physically traversable and contain no hidden blocking voxels
render geometry and walkability derive from one topology contract
streaming keeps active detailed geometry bounded as travel distance grows
seed plus world coordinate regenerates the same architecture
distant silhouettes may preserve continuity without keeping full geometry resident
mobile controls preserve a graphics-first viewport
user-facing MVP links require live verification; hosting status alone is not delivery proof
